---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new capability (new fusion strategy, dataset loader, metric, etc.)
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**What's the gap?**
What can't you currently do with this repo that you'd like to?

**Proposed approach**
If you have one in mind. Reference existing patterns where possible (e.g.
"a new fusion strategy following the same interface as `AdaptiveDynamicFusion`
in `models/fusion/fusion_models.py`").

**Would this need real data to validate?**
Most things in this repo do (see `PRODUCTION_READINESS.md`). If so, note
what dataset would be appropriate and whether you have access to it.
